title: Geometric Phase Effect in Thermodynamic Properties and in the Imaginary-Time Multi-Electronic-State Path Integral Formulation
summary: The geometric phase (GP) is a fundamental quantum effect arising from conical intersections (CIs), with profound consequences for vibronic energy levels. Standard imaginary-time path integral molecular dynamics (PIMD) based on the Born-Oppenheimer approximation does not account for the GP, potentially leading to significant errors in low-temperature thermodynamic properties. In this Perspective, we demonstrate that the multi-electronic-state path integral (MES-PI) formulation in imaginary time (developed in J. Chem.
